verdict.rationale: Twenty documents a developer-first API with both REST and GraphQL endpoints, auto-generated per-workspace documentation, a Metadata API for programmatic schema changes, batching/upsert support, and scoped API keys — and a community user confirms the REST API worked in practice. This provides a documented, usable public API surface suitable for AI-native/agentic access, though the probe found no discoverable OpenAPI spec at standard paths, a minor caveat.
